name: node-raw
description: Minimal Node.js app instrumented with PostHog error tracking, using the raw posthog-cli to inject chunk IDs and upload source maps (no bundler plugin).

scripts.process: posthog-cli --env-file .env sourcemap inject --directory ./dist && posthog-cli --env-file .env sourcemap upload --directory ./dist
scripts.start: pnpm build && pnpm process && node --env-file=.env dist/index.js
